spec_match.rationale: Builds the iamf.<primary>.<additional>.<codec> codecs parameter and asks isTypeSupported, canPlayType and decodingInfo({type:"media-source"}) — the MSE path the feature ships through.

interactive.rationale: All four selects re-probe live; changing container/profile/codec flipped the verdict from "can decode" to "Not supported" with all three API answers shown.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the "four fields and an unhelpful false" angle the feature index promises.

edge_cases.rationale: Out-of-range profile (255), wrong container (webm), and the Opus/opus casing trap are all selectable, with near-miss variants probed side by side.

references.rationale: Cites chromestatus.com/feature/<id> in the see-also block plus the spec/explainer.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite 6/6 PASS here and pairs the IAMF strings with a known-good control and an invented codec, so a negative cannot come from a broken probe.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Playwright headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 against a local server on :3109 (chrome-devtools-mcp not available to this pass): all 4 selects exercised, console and network clean, 360px no overflow; not a chrome-devtools-mcp/Canary pass, and no accessibility-tree inspection.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry is loaded and the page records named assertions for its main measurement; no unexpected errors seen.

design_system.rationale: Inline styles use the design-system variables; button overrides keep text/background pairs readable; not a static card.

accessibility.rationale: Native, labelled controls (no unnamed controls found), visible focus on a Tab walk, and results surfaced as text in status/output regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: At 360×740 documentElement.scrollWidth === innerWidth (wide content scrolls inside its own container) and desktop 1280×800 lays out cleanly.

openQuestions.title: Explain why video/mp4 also reports support
openQuestions.detail: The container select includes video/mp4; the page explains webm but not whether an audio-only IAMF stream in video/mp4 being accepted is expected. One sentence (with a spec/MSE byte-stream reference) would stop readers reading it as a probe bug.

guidanceConsulted.query: audio media element source fallback codec detection with canPlayType and MediaCapabilities
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Do not preload media data the user has not asked for; let the element choose sources by type before fetching.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Observed: the pages only query support APIs and type-gated <source> lists; no media bytes are preloaded. No change required by this critique.
